confirm.title: Confirm the distance unit
confirm.description:
LubeLogger stores odometer readings as plain numbers and its API does not report which unit they are in, so **{title}** was set up with a unit guessed from your Home Assistant unit system.

Check **Settings** → **Formatting** in LubeLogger. It reports miles when either "Use imperial calculation for fuel mileage (MPG)" or "Use UK MPG calculation" is enabled, and kilometers when both are off.

If the guess was wrong, the Odometer sensor has been reading about 1.6× too high or too low. Correcting it here will leave a step in the sensor history.
